failure_target: R2 could predict across unseen repositories/families/languages but failed to generalize to a completely unseen intervention family; full AUROC 0.58494 was below 0.62 and slightly below the no-cross control.
r3_hypothesis: A structurally constrained compositional model that represents a program as primitive susceptibilities and an intervention as strengths on the same primitive axes can extrapolate an intervention effect from primitive geometry even when the intervention-family identity has never appeared during training.

representation.name: Aligned Primitive Susceptibility x Action Model
allowed_full_features: aligned products p[k]*i[k] only when primitive key k exists on both sides
forbidden_full_features: arbitrary p[k]*i[j] products for k != j
representation.reason: The model must earn unseen-intervention transfer from primitive semantics, not memorize a family label or fit an unconstrained interaction matrix that is underdetermined when a family is removed.

controls.no_alignment: Same program/intervention/environment/language main effects but no p[k]*i[k] aligned susceptibility terms.
controls.static_only: Program primitives plus environment/language context, no intervention primitive values.
controls.intervention_only: Intervention primitive values plus environment/language context, no program primitives.
controls.global_permutation: Five coherent row permutations of all outcome targets inside each training fold.
controls.stratified_permutation: Five coherent row permutations inside intervention_family x repository_family strata.
controls.r2_full: Predecessor diagnostic only; not a success baseline because it already failed the target stress test.

kill_rules: Any frozen synthetic R3 gate failure => do not open real intervention data.
If intervention-family transfer still fails, kill the current IPWM compositional route rather than create R3.1 with weaker gates.
If validity null remains above 0.62, real-data execution is blocked even if speedup prediction passes.
Synthetic R3 pass cannot be described as real transfer, causal search benefit, novelty, or breakthrough.
novelty_boundary: Compiler cost models and causal/evidence-driven optimization already exist. A future defensible claim would require prospective cross-repository compositional intervention transfer and causal search improvement over strong controls; R3 itself is only a falsification prerequisite.
